svg.text: Offline Hard-Target Refinement: D3PM → MNO → Retokenize
Non-differentiable closed loop: realized trajectories provide clean supervision
Iterative reverse denoising (T → 0) with RePaint inpainting
Observed tokens held fixed; masked positions completed
θ_pred [B,14] + u0_pred [B,C,H,W] — sampled from learned posterior
Output: trajectory [B, T+1, C, H, W]
Target at masked positions = realized tokens (not GT)
Same CE loss as DiffusionTrainer, lower LR for stability
Repeat 3x (configurable via num_refinement_cycles). Each cycle: generate + filter + fine-tune.
Why Hard Targets Instead of E2E Gradients?
Backpropagating through 512 chaotic MNO steps produces noisy, uninformative gradients.
Hard targets provide a clean, non-differentiable supervision signal: "these tokens ARE realizable."
